title: Agriculture Minister Matia Chowdhury at Integrated Pest Management Training Program Discussion, Dhaka, 2018-05-29 (PID-0044058)
description: On Tuesday, May 29, 2018, the Minister of Agriculture, Matia Chowdhury, addressed a discussion session at her ministry in the Secretariat, Dhaka, concerning a regional training program on Integrated Pest Management for SAARC member states. This information comes from the Press Information Department.
